note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Event A is a generic fictional event and the consequences are generic fictional objects; no person is drawn and nobody is injured. The two rings are ONLY the supplied grouping: the inner ring holds the consequences supplied as 'Immediate consequence (as supplied)', the outer ring those supplied as 'Subsequent consequence (as supplied) — to be examined', with identical stroke, colour and weight; neither is shown as excluded, lesser or decided. No remoteness or scope doctrine, test, liability, amount, outcome or jurisdiction is stated. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events (the supplied consequences, each with its supplied ring), causalLinks, alternatives, losses (the grouping as supplied), actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are all editable; 'origin' is added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; scene-area floor >= 0.20 of the frame in every preset, accepted LAW-0701..0708). True driver: the 1:1 box — the physical scene (plate with its event, objects, rings and posts, plus the floor) must cover >= 0.20 of the frame area while the stress text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: every composition (side, split, tall = right-hand column, below, below2) and the compact-list composition (plate left, right-hand column with the grouping chip, the record and the legend as a compact list continuing under the plate). Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy in production/scratch/causation-08/LAW-0709.stress-precap.json): full counts (six consequences, two accounts, one labelled link, two grouping items, two notes) → compact list 17 px, scene area 0.121; five consequences → 0.138; four consequences → 0.153; one account and one note → 0.143; four consequences, one account, one note → 0.190; the same with one grouping item → 0.211 (0.202 once the event name was shortened to keep its parenthetical on one line — under the 2 px margin); the same without the link note → 0.217. The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four consequences (the first four: two inner, two outer), one account put forward (the first), one grouping item (the first), one note (the first) and no link note — baseline 3 / 0 / 1 / 1 / 0; every text field keeps its near-maximum length and stays strictly longer than the baseline.
